name: link_entities
description: Resolve names, aliases or ids (e.g. 'ledger-service', 'RDS-42') to entity ids.

name: get_owner
description: Who owns a system or project, with the owning team's lead, citations and any open dispute.

name: get_history
description: Every assertion in an entity's chain for a predicate (OWNS, LEADS, MEMBER_OF, DEPENDS_ON, ...).

name: trace_decision
description: Why a decision was made: replacement chain, deciders, what it affects, motivating source spans.

name: find_experts
description: Who knows about an entity, with a per-signal breakdown.

name: find_paths
description: Typed paths between two entities. Without to_id: impact mode (what depends on it and who to tell).

name: count_related
description: Count and list the entities of a label (System, Team, Person, ...) linked to an entity by one relation

name: rank_by_count
description: Rank the entities of a label by how many related entities they have, e.g. Team by MEMBER_OF Person

name: search_spans
description: Hybrid text search over source spans (text-only evidence).

name: query_graph
description: Last resort: read-only generated Cypher, labelled unverified.

name: explain_action
description: What an action relied on and produced, then versus now, and who confirmed it.

name: recall_session
description: The user's own earlier turns (needs a token session).

name: route_to_owner
description: Propose routing a ticket to the current owner's lead (becomes real only on confirm).

name: draft_adr_supersession
description: Draft an ADR that supersedes decision_id (proposals; nothing changes until confirmed).

name: flag_stale_docs
description: Find documents whose latest revision still states a superseded fact; draft corrections.

name: learn_fact
description: Learn a fact from a user's chat turn. Over MCP there is no user-authored session span to quote,

name: confirm_fact
description: Confirm a disputed or proposed fact as the configured actor (graph authorisation applies).

name: undo_action
description: Undo an action as the configured actor (graph authorisation applies).
